Jane · Listen & Shadow 05

The Friday Report — reporting back, rebuilding trust
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · THE BRIEF
👤 Friend
Here's the brief: minus 150, 72 hours, no replacement, one box per person.
조건은 이래요. 영하 150도, 72시간, 대체 불가, 한 상자에 한 사람 몫.
brief — 조건 요약 · replacement — 대체품
💬 Jane
First I'd ask where it's going.
먼저 목적지가 어디인지부터 물어볼 거예요.
first I'd ask ~ — 먼저 ~부터 물어볼 거예요
같은 패턴으로 — First I'd ask who's receiving it. · First I'd ask about the deadline.
💬 Jane
It depends on whether there's a direct flight.
직항이 있느냐 없느냐에 따라 달라져요.
depend on ~ — ~에 달려 있다 · direct flight — 직항
같은 패턴으로 — It depends on whether customs is open that day. · It depends on the weather that week.
💬 Jane
Is there any room in the 72 hours, or is that hard?
시간에 여유가 있나요, 아니면 딱 72시간인가요?
room — 여유 · hard — 엄격한, 못 바꾸는
같은 패턴으로 — Is there any room in the budget? · Is that date hard, or can it move?
PART 2 · THE PLAN
👤 Friend
So how would you move it?
그럼 어떻게 보낼 거예요?
move — 옮기다, 운송하다
💬 Jane
I'd go with a direct flight, because every transfer is a risk.
저라면 항공 직항으로 갈 거예요. 환적은 위험이니까요.
go with ~ — ~를 택하다 · transfer — 환적
같은 패턴으로 — I'd go with air, because sea is too slow. · I'd go with the earlier flight, because of the buffer.
💬 Jane
The risk there is the airline delaying.
거기서 위험한 건 항공사 지연이에요.
risk — 위험 요소 · delay — 지연되다
같은 패턴으로 — The risk there is a customs hold. · The risk there is the dry ice running out.
💬 Jane
As a backup, I'd book a second flight.
혹시 몰라서 두 번째 항공편도 예약해둘 거예요.
as a backup — 만약을 대비해 · book — 예약하다
같은 패턴으로 — As a backup, I'd have a second driver ready. · As a backup, I'd pack extra dry ice.
💬 Jane
At the other end, a named person has to sign for it.
도착지에서는 지정된 사람이 직접 받아야 해요.
at the other end — 도착지에서 · sign for ~ — ~를 인수하다
같은 패턴으로 — A named person has to receive it. · Someone has to sign for it in person.
PART 3 · THE REVEAL
👤 Friend
Here's what's in the box: cells from a patient, edited, going back to that same patient.
이 상자, 사실은 환자 세포로 만든 약이에요. 그 환자에게 돌아가요.
cell — 세포 · edit — 고치다
💬 Jane
I didn't expect that.
그건 생각도 못 했어요.
expect — 예상하다
같은 패턴으로 — I didn't expect it to be that personal. · I didn't expect the price.
💬 Jane
Ah — so that's why there's no replacement.
아, 그래서 대체품이 없는 거군요.
so that's why ~ — 그래서 ~인 거구나
같은 패턴으로 — So that's why the box has a name on it. · So that's why they hand-deliver it.
💬 Jane
I had the direct flight and the hand-off right.
직항이랑 직접 인수는 제가 맞췄네요.
hand-off — 인수인계 · have ~ right — ~를 맞히다
같은 패턴으로 — I had the backup right. · I had that one right.
💬 Jane
Shipping being 20 to 40 percent of the cost — that surprised me.
운송비가 전체의 20~40%라는 건 놀랍네요.
surprise — 놀라게 하다
같은 패턴으로 — The price tag surprised me. · The charter flights surprised me.
PART 4 · YOUR OWN CASE
👤 Friend
What's the hardest shipment you handled at FedEx?
FedEx에서 제일 까다로웠던 화물은요?
handle — 처리하다
💬 Jane
The tricky part was the customs paperwork kept changing.
까다로웠던 건 통관 서류가 계속 바뀌는 거였어요.
tricky — 까다로운 · paperwork — 서류 작업
같은 패턴으로 — The tricky part was the timing. · The tricky part was the customer not answering.
💬 Jane
What we did was call the customer every day to confirm.
저희가 한 건 고객한테 매일 전화해서 확인한 거였어요.
confirm — 확인하다
같은 패턴으로 — What we did was split the order in two. · What we did was hold it until the papers came.
💬 Jane
Looking back, I'd have flagged it earlier.
지금 생각하면, 더 일찍 알렸을 거예요.
flag — 미리 알리다
같은 패턴으로 — Looking back, I'd have asked for a backup. · Looking back, I'd have called first.
💬 Jane
There, I never had to worry about temperature.
거기선 온도 걱정은 안 해도 됐죠.
worry about ~ — ~를 걱정하다
같은 패턴으로 — There, I never had to worry about a name on the box. · I never had to think about dry ice.
느리게 19/19 · 보통 19/19
